lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  have h : (mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂ T =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) := by
    apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
    intro φs'
    apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
    intro φs
    change ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
      ofCrAnListFBasis φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * ofCrAnListFBasis φs))
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
    let l1 :=
      List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let l2 :=
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
    have hs (t : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
        (ht : ∀ c ∈ t, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
        ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ t ++ φs)) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ t ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF t) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' t φs ht]
      simp only [l1, l2, List.append_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul,
        map_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h12 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h21 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.append_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofCrAnListF_nil,
      map_one, mul_one] at h12 h21 h0
    calc
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF,
            ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
            ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
            List.nil_append, map_sub, map_smul]
        rw [h12, h21, ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one, map_sub, map_smul,
          map_mul, smul_sub, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
          Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        rw [smul_comm]
      _ = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
          ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) := by
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
          (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
        rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, h0, mul_assoc]
        by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
        · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
            Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
            ← crAnTimeOrderSign, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
        · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f a b) h
